bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/bug-report-20261115"
test -d "$WT" || exit 31
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 32
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/bug-report-userbot-20261115 >/dev/null
SHA=08faea09efc9194f29ea31264fca6e5dd82effa4
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$SHA" || exit 33
git -C "$WT" checkout --detach "$SHA" >/dev/null
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA" || exit 34
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-08faea0 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile|TS[0-9]{4}' "$LOG"; then exit 51; fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$LOG"; then exit 52; fi
 exit 55
fi
docker run --rm --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-08faea0 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs || exit 56
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-08faea0 -c 'grep -q "dm:bug:open" /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "GAYBBS_USERBOT_REPORT_CHAT_ID_FILE" /app/gaybbs.mjs' || exit 57
printf 'GAYBBS_REPORT_IMAGE=BUILT\nSOURCE_SHA_VERIFIED=YES\n'
